['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\nset +e\n\nAPT_MIRROR="http://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/debian"\nAPT_SECURITY_MIRROR="http://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/debian-security"\nUV_INDEX_URL="https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple"\n\nif [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]; then\n    cp /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.bak || true\n    sed -i \\\n        -e "s|http://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|http://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        /etc/apt/sources.list\nfi\n\nif [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]; then\n    cp /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources.bak || true\n    sed -i \\\n        -e "s|http://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://deb.debian.org/debian|${APT_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|http://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        -e "s|https://security.debian.org/debian-security|${APT_SECURITY_MIRROR}|g" \\\n        /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources\nfi\n\nmkdir -p /root/.config/uv\ncat > /root/.config/uv/uv.toml <<EOF\nindex-url = "${UV_INDEX_URL}"\nEOF\n\napt-get update || true\ntrue', 'Enter']

['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/MdfLib/stdafx.h <<\'PY\'\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\nold_str = \'#include <windows.h>\'\nnew_str = \'#if defined(_WIN32)\\n#include <windows.h>\\n#endif\'\n\ndef normalize_text(text: str) -> str:\n    text = text.replace(\'\\r\\n\', \'\\n\').replace(\'\\r\', \'\\n\')\n    return \'\\n\'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.split(\'\\n\'))\n\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'r\', encoding=\'utf-8\', errors=\'replace\') as f:\n        content = f.read()\nexcept FileNotFoundError:\n    print(f"错误: 找不到文件 {path}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"修改失败: {exc}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\n\ncontent = normalize_text(content)\nold_str = normalize_text(old_str)\nnew_str = normalize_text(new_str)\ncount = content.count(old_str)\nif count == 0:\n    print("错误: 在文件中找不到 old_str。\\n建议：\\n1. 使用 read_file(raw_mode=True) 获取原始内容\\n2. 检查是否有多余的空格或换行符\\n3. 如果文件较大，考虑使用 write_full_file 全量覆盖")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nif count > 1:\n    print(f"错误: 匹配到 {count} 处相同的代码，请提供更具体的 old_str 以确保唯一性。")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nwith open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n    f.write(content.replace(old_str, new_str))\nprint(f"成功: 已更新 {path}。修改已持久化。")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/MdfLib/CMakeLists.txt <<\'PY\'\nimport os\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\ncontent = \'cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)\\nproject(MdfLib LANGUAGES CXX)\\n\\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)\\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\\n\\nadd_library(mdflib STATIC\\n    MdfFormat.cpp\\n    stdafx.cpp\\n)\\ntarget_include_directories(mdflib PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})\\ntarget_compile_definitions(mdflib PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)\\n\\nadd_executable(mdf_converter converter.cpp)\\ntarget_link_libraries(mdf_converter PRIVATE mdflib)\\n\\ninclude(CTest)\\nif(BUILD_TESTING)\\n  add_test(NAME converter_smoke\\n    COMMAND mdf_converter\\n      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test_models/bunbun.mdf\\n      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bunbun.json)\\nendif()\\n\'\ndir_path = os.path.dirname(path)\nif dir_path:\n    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n        f.write(content)\n    print(f"成功: 已写入 {path}")\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"写入失败: {exc}")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/MdfLib/converter.cpp <<\'PY\'\nimport os\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\ncontent = \'#include "MdfFormat.h"\\n\\n#include <cstdio>\\n#include <fstream>\\n#include <iostream>\\n#include <string>\\n\\nclass FileStream final : public MdfStream {\\npublic:\\n    explicit FileStream(const char *path) : file_(std::fopen(path, "rb")) {}\\n    ~FileStream() override { if (file_) std::fclose(file_); }\\n    bool valid() const { return file_ != nullptr; }\\n    bool Seek(int offset, int origin) override { return file_ && std::fseek(file_, offset, origin) == 0; }\\n    int Tell() override { return file_ ? static_cast<int>(std::ftell(file_)) : -1; }\\n    int Read(void *buffer, int size) override { return file_ ? static_cast<int>(std::fread(buffer, 1, size, file_)) : 0; }\\nprivate:\\n    std::FILE *file_;\\n};\\n\\nstatic std::string json_escape(const std::string &value) {\\n    std::string result;\\n    for (char c : value) {\\n        if (c == \\\'\\\\\\\\\\\') result += "\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\";\\n        else if (c == \\\'"\\\') result += "\\\\\\\\\\\\"";\\n        else if (c == \\\'\\\\n\\\') result += "\\\\\\\\n";\\n        else if (c == \\\'\\\\r\\\') result += "\\\\\\\\r";\\n        else if (c == \\\'\\\\t\\\') result += "\\\\\\\\t";\\n        else result += c;\\n    }\\n    return result;\\n}\\n\\nint main(int argc, char **argv) {\\n    if (argc != 3) {\\n        std::cerr << "usage: mdf_converter INPUT.mdf OUTPUT.json\\\\n";\\n        return 2;\\n    }\\n\\n    FileStream input(argv[1]);\\n    if (!input.valid()) {\\n        std::cerr << "cannot open input: " << argv[1] << \\\'\\\\n\\\';\\n        return 1;\\n    }\\n    MdfFormat model;\\n    if (!model.LoadFromStream(input)) {\\n        std::cerr << "cannot parse MDF: " << argv[1] << \\\'\\\\n\\\';\\n        return 1;\\n    }\\n\\n    std::ofstream output(argv[2]);\\n    if (!output) {\\n        std::cerr << "cannot open output: " << argv[2] << \\\'\\\\n\\\';\\n        return 1;\\n    }\\n    output << "{\\\\n"\\n           << "  \\\\"format\\\\": \\\\"MDF\\\\",\\\\n"\\n           << "  \\\\"format_version\\\\": 1,\\\\n"\\n           << "  \\\\"source\\\\": \\\\"" << json_escape(argv[1]) << "\\\\",\\\\n"\\n           << "  \\\\"meshes\\\\": {\\\\"count\\\\": " << model.GetNumMeshes() << "},\\\\n"\\n           << "  \\\\"animations\\\\": {\\\\"count\\\\": " << model.GetNumAnimations() << "},\\\\n"\\n           << "  \\\\"textures\\\\": {\\\\"count\\\\": " << model.GetNumTextures() << "}\\\\n"\\n           << "}\\\\n";\\n    return output.good() ? 0 : 1;\\n}\\n\'\ndir_path = os.path.dirname(path)\nif dir_path:\n    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n        f.write(content)\n    print(f"成功: 已写入 {path}")\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"写入失败: {exc}")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']

['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/MdfLib/MdfFormat.cpp <<\'PY\'\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\nold_str = \'#include "StdAfx.h"\'\nnew_str = \'#include "stdafx.h"\'\n\ndef normalize_text(text: str) -> str:\n    text = text.replace(\'\\r\\n\', \'\\n\').replace(\'\\r\', \'\\n\')\n    return \'\\n\'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.split(\'\\n\'))\n\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'r\', encoding=\'utf-8\', errors=\'replace\') as f:\n        content = f.read()\nexcept FileNotFoundError:\n    print(f"错误: 找不到文件 {path}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"修改失败: {exc}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\n\ncontent = normalize_text(content)\nold_str = normalize_text(old_str)\nnew_str = normalize_text(new_str)\ncount = content.count(old_str)\nif count == 0:\n    print("错误: 在文件中找不到 old_str。\\n建议：\\n1. 使用 read_file(raw_mode=True) 获取原始内容\\n2. 检查是否有多余的空格或换行符\\n3. 如果文件较大，考虑使用 write_full_file 全量覆盖")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nif count > 1:\n    print(f"错误: 匹配到 {count} 处相同的代码，请提供更具体的 old_str 以确保唯一性。")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nwith open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n    f.write(content.replace(old_str, new_str))\nprint(f"成功: 已更新 {path}。修改已持久化。")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
['export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0\npython3 - /app/MdfLib/converter.cpp <<\'PY\'\nimport sys\npath = sys.argv[1]\nold_str = \'    bool Seek(int offset, int origin) override { return file_ && std::fseek(file_, offset, origin) == 0; }\\n    int Tell() override { return file_ ? static_cast<int>(std::ftell(file_)) : -1; }\\n    int Read(void *buffer, int size) override { return file_ ? static_cast<int>(std::fread(buffer, 1, size, file_)) : 0; }\\nprivate:\\n    std::FILE *file_;\\n};\'\nnew_str = \'    bool Seek(int offset, int origin) override { return file_ && std::fseek(file_, offset, origin) == 0; }\\n    int Tell() override { return file_ ? static_cast<int>(std::ftell(file_)) : -1; }\\n    int Read(void *buffer, int size) override { return file_ ? static_cast<int>(std::fread(buffer, 1, size, file_)) : 0; }\\n    int Length() override {\\n        if (!file_) return 0;\\n        long current = std::ftell(file_);\\n        if (current < 0) return 0;\\n        if (std::fseek(file_, 0, SEEK_END) != 0) return 0;\\n        long end = std::ftell(file_);\\n        std::fseek(file_, current, SEEK_SET);\\n        return end < 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(end);\\n    }\\nprivate:\\n    std::FILE *file_;\\n};\'\n\ndef normalize_text(text: str) -> str:\n    text = text.replace(\'\\r\\n\', \'\\n\').replace(\'\\r\', \'\\n\')\n    return \'\\n\'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.split(\'\\n\'))\n\ntry:\n    with open(path, \'r\', encoding=\'utf-8\', errors=\'replace\') as f:\n        content = f.read()\nexcept FileNotFoundError:\n    print(f"错误: 找不到文件 {path}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nexcept Exception as exc:\n    print(f"修改失败: {exc}")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\n\ncontent = normalize_text(content)\nold_str = normalize_text(old_str)\nnew_str = normalize_text(new_str)\ncount = content.count(old_str)\nif count == 0:\n    print("错误: 在文件中找不到 old_str。\\n建议：\\n1. 使用 read_file(raw_mode=True) 获取原始内容\\n2. 检查是否有多余的空格或换行符\\n3. 如果文件较大，考虑使用 write_full_file 全量覆盖")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nif count > 1:\n    print(f"错误: 匹配到 {count} 处相同的代码，请提供更具体的 old_str 以确保唯一性。")\n    raise SystemExit(0)\nwith open(path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\', newline=\'\\n\') as f:\n    f.write(content.replace(old_str, new_str))\nprint(f"成功: 已更新 {path}。修改已持久化。")\nPY\ntrue', 'Enter']
